ItemID: 1; Title: AMOLEN PLA 3D Printer Filament,PLA Filament 1.75mm Shiny Filament Color Change Purple Blue,3D Printing Filament 1KG/2.2lb; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I’m focused on workshop repairs and fastening projects, with no current need for decorative printing filament.
ItemID: 2; Title: OVERTURE PLA Filament 1.75mm PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1kg Cardboard Spool (2.2lbs), Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03mm, Fit Most FDM Printer (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I don’t have a current 3D printing project that calls for this material.
ItemID: 3; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Orange filament doesn’t address my immediate needs for tools and repair supplies.
ItemID: 4; Title: eSUN PLA PRO (PLA+) 3D Printer Filament, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 1kg Spool, 1.75mm, Light Brown; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Even a practical printing material needs a specific project and compatible equipment before I would buy it.
ItemID: 5; Title: Silk Pearl White PLA Filament 1.75 mm 3D Printer Filament Consumables 1KG 2.2LBS Spool Fit Most FDM Printer Silky Shine Shiny 3D Printing Material CC3D Silk White Color; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A shiny decorative finish isn’t something I need for my current repair work.
ItemID: 6; Title: 3D Solutech Real White 3D Printer PLA Filament 1.75MM Filament, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 2.2 LBS (1.0KG) - PLA175RWHT, PLA175WHT; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would pass on stocking filament without a current printing use for it.
ItemID: 7; Title: Nut & Bolt Thread Checker (Inch & Metric), Original Version (SWTC-26), Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to identify threads across my metric bolts and inch-sized rivet nuts and avoid mismatched hardware.
ItemID: 8; Title: TTYT3D Silk Shine Emerald Green 3D Printer PLA Filament, 1.75mm 3D Printing Material Widely Compatible of 3D Printer, 1KG 2.2LBS Silk Shiny Green PLA with Extra 10pcs 3D Printer Tool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The shiny green finish and included tools don’t give me a reason to start buying printing supplies now.
ItemID: 9; Title: YOYI YOYI 3D Printer Filament,PETG Filament 1.75mm 2.2lbs(1kg) Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm,100% New Raw Material; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: PETG could suit fabricated parts, but I have no current printing project to justify choosing it.
ItemID: 10; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for small workshop repairs where a bonding compound could complement my mechanical fasteners.
